title: Expectation of a Walsh character as a coordinate product
statement:
Let $n$ be a natural number and let $S \subseteq [n]$ be a nonempty set of coordinates. Then the uniform expectation of the Walsh character $\chi_S$ over the Boolean hypercube factorises as a product over the coordinates in $S$:
\[
  \mathbb{E}[\chi_S]
  \;=\; \prod_{j \in S}
        \frac{\mathrm{BoolToPM1}(\mathtt{false}) + \mathrm{BoolToPM1}(\mathtt{true})}{2},
\]
where $\mathrm{BoolToPM1}$ sends $\mathtt{false}$ to $1$ and $\mathtt{true}$ to $-1$.
replaced:
For a non-empty $S \subseteq [n]$, the uniform expectation of the character $\chi_S$
factorises over the coordinates of $S$:
\[
  \mathbb{E}[\chi_S]
  \;=\; \prod_{j \in S}
        \frac{\mathrm{BoolToPM1}(\mathtt{false}) + \mathrm{BoolToPM1}(\mathtt{true})}{2}.
\]
